Removes a known bottleneck in SPY-6 RMA production, supporting higher build rates.
In-house mfg in CA and NV
Vertical integration can improve lead times, margins, and delivery reliability.
Two-year qual with Raytheon & US Navy
Deepens program credibility and positions Lyntris as a trusted source.
Exposure to a long-duration Navy program can drive sustained orders.
Platform capability may open additional defense manufacturing revenue.

This is an execution milestone within Lyntris’ strategy to vertically integrate and de-risk defense supply chains tied to enduring Navy platforms. For a larger catalyst, investors need visibility to firm orders, volume commitments, or revenue contribution from this qualification.
